programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: As the Roman Empire expands its reaches into what is now Germany, its legions are faced with ferocious Germanic tribesmen. In 9 AD, their chieftain, Arminius, raised in Rome as a hostage of peace, uses his Roman military training to slaughter the Roman General Varus' army at Teutoburg Forest. This landmark battle establishes the Rhine River as the frontier between the Empire and its growing barbaric enemies. Six years later, when General Germanicus sets out across the Rhine for revenge, he finds heaps of bones and severed skulls nailed to trees - a reminder of the barbarians' victory. But at the Battle of the Weser River, he faces Arminius and wins. Germanicus captures Arminius' pregnant wife, Thusnelda, and parades her through the streets of Rome, as a symbol of his triumph.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: After a truly trash year, actor, producer, and New York Times bestselling author Phoebe Robinson is finally out of quarantine and ready to get back onstage. Bringing her signature brand of authentic confessional humor to her first-ever solo stand-up special, Robinson gets real about therapy, interracial dating, reparations, hanging out with Michelle Obama, aging out of watching civil rights movies, and more in a no-holds-barred hour of comedy that's both unflinchingly honest – and uniquely hilarious.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: As the Roman Empire expands its reaches into what is now Germany, its legions are faced with ferocious Germanic tribesmen. In 9 AD, their chieftain, Arminius, raised in Rome as a hostage of peace, uses his Roman military training to slaughter the Roman General Varus' army at Teutoburg Forest. This landmark battle establishes the Rhine River as the frontier between the Empire and its growing barbaric enemies. Six years later, when General Germanicus sets out across the Rhine for revenge, he finds heaps of bones and severed skulls nailed to trees - a reminder of the barbarians' victory. But at the Battle of the Weser River, he faces Arminius and wins. Germanicus captures Arminius' pregnant wife, Thusnelda, and parades her through the streets of Rome, as a symbol of his triumph.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: After a truly trash year, actor, producer, and New York Times bestselling author Phoebe Robinson is finally out of quarantine and ready to get back onstage. Bringing her signature brand of authentic confessional humor to her first-ever solo stand-up special, Robinson gets real about therapy, interracial dating, reparations, hanging out with Michelle Obama, aging out of watching civil rights movies, and more in a no-holds-barred hour of comedy that's both unflinchingly honest – and uniquely hilarious.

programme.title: Lost Gold of WW2
programme.desc: It is the last great mystery of WWII. The fabled Yamashita Treasure, a massive stash of gold bars and rubies worth billions, reportedly dumped in a cave by Japanese soldiers retreating from allied forces. While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: В Грузии есть знаменитый детский курорт Уреки с лечебными магнитными песками. Летом он превращается в самый настоящий детский городок. Песок местного пляжа действительно творит чудеса, и малыши с проблемами опорно-двигательного аппарата за летний сезон начинают идти на поправку. Такими же свойствами песок обладает и в селах Магнетити и Шекветили. За последние годы Шекветили стал любимым местом отдыха многих гостей Грузии. Этому способствует современная инфраструктура курортной зоны, большие и современные отели, зеленый хвойный лес. В Шекветили на 60 гектаров раскинулся грандиозный дендропарк с редкой флорой и фауной. Дендропарк поражает уникальной коллекцией деревьев-гигантов и растений, которые свозили в Грузию с пяти континентов. В искусственно созданной среде живут 57 видов экзотических птиц и животных. А гурманов порадуют блюда местной рыбной кухни.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Останьтесь навсегда
programme.desc: Главная героиня фильма - Валерия - преуспевающий адвокат, красивая, независимая и самодостаточная женщина, уверена, что контролирует все в своей жизни. Но эта иллюзия рушится после того, как судьба сводит Валерию с бывшим бизнесменом Михаилом и его шестилетней дочерью. Михаил недавно освободился из тюрьмы, куда попал по несправедливому обвинению. Чтобы не потерять свою дочь, он вынужден похитить ее из детского дома, куда девочку поместили после ареста отца и бегства матери, бросившей малышку на посторонних людей и уехавшей за границу в поисках нового богатого мужа. Похитив дочь, Михаил вынужден скрываться. Его разыскивает полиция. Обстоятельства складываются так, что истории Валерии и Михаила тесно переплетаются. Но когда Валерия узнает, что ее любимый человек - \"похититель ребенка\" - она оказывается перед трудным выбором: поступить по закону или по совести. Какой путь выберет героиня?

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Проект Ирины Хангошвили о культуре, истории и традициях различных стран мира. Ведущий - Зураб Двали - путешествует и приглашает зрителей пройтись вместе с ним по красивым местам, увидеть достопримечательности, полюбоваться природой и познакомиться с интересными людьми. Всюду гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Зрители сначала узнают интересные исторические факты о самых известных или забытых регионах различных стран, и затем останавливаются на кулинарных традициях - готовят несколько блюд с гостями программы.

programme.title: Отель счастливых сердец
programme.desc: Вера - красавица, умница, самостоятельная женщина, строгая мать двух взрослых дочерей. Несколько лет назад ее любимый муж пропал без вести в Африке, и с тех пор Вера одна ведет семью и семейный бизнес, небольшой отель. Под ее неусыпным контролем всё - в идеальном порядке. Но долго так не бывает, и Верин аккуратный мир уже рушится - старые увлечения, новое чувство, африканские страсти, циничные интриги и трагическое стечение обстоятельств…

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: Надежда считает дни до рождения желанного малыша. Но с полоски на тесте для беременности, в ее жизни началась большая черная полоса. Сначала она чуть не потеряла ребенка, которого врачи спасли в самый последний момент, и едва оправившись от шока, судьба наносит ей очередной страшный удар — смерть отца. В отчаянии, без пяти минут мама, обратилась за помощью к Зулие Раджабовой и Николь Кузнецовой.

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Любовь зла
programme.desc: Харизматичный вор-домушник Максим попадает в неприятности, задолжав деньги опасным бандитам. Во время очередного ограбления он становится свидетелем отчаянного поступка, который совершает неожиданно вернувшаяся хозяйка квартиры Ева: она пытается сжечь всё, что напоминает о парне-предателе, и вдобавок покончить жизнь самоубийством. Максим решает остановить Еву и уберечь себя от еще больших проблем.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Пентагон
programme.desc: В первой серии мы знакомимся с обитателями "Пентагона" — дома, в котором нет канализации и отопления, течет крыша, отваливаются перила балкона и двери подъезда. Герои фильма — как матросы на тонущем корабле — бегают от одной пробоины к другой, пытаясь их залатать, но жаловаться в администрацию боятся: \"как бы не было хуже\". Хотя, казалось бы, куда уже хуже?

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny celebrate a brand new arrival to the family: a body lotion that delivers incredible speed to its wearer. Yay Science! The boys quickly include the speed lotion in their morning routine, because testing inventions on yourself is always a good idea. Then it's time to get out there and nab Lamput once and for all. Results are mixed. On the one hand, the "zoom oil" certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things. Conclusion: the docs still fail, only this time they fail really quickly. At least they get that round the world trip they were dreaming of.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: As Skips continues to help everyone with problems relating to broken supplies, Mordecai and Rigby are attempting to print something, but encounter error # 219. programme.title: Adventure Time

They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai and Rigby beat Muscle Man and High-Five Ghost in a cart race and pick up some girls who have some flat tires. However they soon destroy the cart so Benson punishes them by taking away their cart privileges and forcing them to ride kiddie bikes. Angered at the "uncoolness of the bikes Mordecai protests the decision due to them taking away their cool appeal. He strikes a deal with Benson: if Benson admits that they're cool then they can get their cart privileges back. Mordecai and Rigby do whatever they can wearing cool sunglasses dressing up in stylish clothes but Benson refuses to admit that they are cool. Trouble ensues when the cool police arrest Mordecai and Rigby for being too cool and they are taken to a distant planet for trial. Benson is then called over as a witness where he finally admits that Mordecai and Rigby are cool. The judge determines their sentence - death. Mordecai Rigby and Benson all escape alive after setting the planet to detonate.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons discover a family of cartoon copycats who mimic their every move. / Grandpa Louie has a new online friend - the only problem is she isn't real. / The kids find out that Richard has been being picked on by the same person since high school. / Gumball and Darwin decide to use online reviews to wrangle free stuff. / A mysterious package shows up at the Watterson's house and they do their best to avoid opening it. / Darwin likes a girl in his class so Gumball decides it's time to play cupid. / Gumball's smart answers aren't the correct ones and he's forced to go back to kindergarten. / Gumball and Darwin discover the real reason Dad's diet wasn't working. / Gumball discovers that Rob his old nemesis is neme-seeing someone else now.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons complain about their day and order a pizza from Larry... / The citizens of Elmore are feeling down because it's January, so Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday called Sluzzle Tag. / In Biology class, Gumball and Darwin are waiting for a butterfly to emerge from its chrysalis. / After Gumball and Darwin have too much sugary cereal they begin thinking about the mysteries of the universe. / Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Banana Joe's mom paints pictures which predict the future. / When Mr Small shows a health and safety video in class, Darwin becomes obsessed with the idea of keeping the Wattersons safe. / Anais throws a party but no-one shows up as she has no friends or social skills. / Alan is so good-natured that Gumball feels compelled to make him lose his temper. / Things aren't going Gumball's way at school so he assumes there must be a Secret Society...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.desc: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences. / Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mum and Dad for being old their voices start to break. / Sarah the new kid in school is Gumball and Darwin's number one slightly obsessive fan. / The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. / Miss Simian has to save herself from a contagious Joy virus infecting the whole school. / The secret behind Anton's immortality. / The kids finally get the puppy they always wanted except it's a turtle. / When Mum reveals that Gumball's real name is Zach Gumball adopts a cheesy annoying persona to match the name. / Nothing much is happening for Gumball and Darwin and the background characters in Elmore seize their moment.

Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Xplore Oman
programme.desc: Documentary series. A world of rich and vibrant culture awaits in this stunning travel series exploring the historic country of Oman. Known officially as the Sultanate of Oman and positioned on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, the show explores the staggering history behind this beautiful kingdom. With a population of just over 4 million, this uniquely untouched country is still finding its feet in the Western tourism industry. From its four UNESCO World Heritage sites, which in itself reveals the extraordinary history and architecture that exists in Oman, to its famed horse-breeding, Oman is a country that will undoubtedly surprise you.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Pärast suuri segadusi ja isegi mõrva, suudab Freya siiski keerulise mosaiigi kokku panna ja mõrva lahendada. Kaur Moks otsustab oma jüngritele üles tunnistada, et ta neile valetas, et tal puuduvad üleloomulikud võimed. Kuid nüüd kogeb guru omaenda nahal, mis tunne on siis, kui karma su kätte saab.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Kristna ja võluva rätsepa suhtes tekib ootamatu pööre. Tüdrukud otsustavad ülekuumenenud Kristinale vastu hakata ja Laurast saab nende ühisfirma uus juht. Miša saab oma ebamugava pärandusemaja kohta jahmatava teate. Maria kohtub oma raamatu tõttu sarmika noore kirjaniku Osvaldiga ja Kristina leiab endale uue märklaua.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika on Egiptusest tagasi ja otsustab nüüd ennast töö juures jõuliselt kehtestada. Reinu äi saab teada, et Renate kaotas töö ja kihutab linnaperekonna kriisikoosolekule. Jaoskonda ilmub uus salapärane töötaja ja uus ülemus sepitseb salakavala Urmasega midagi vägagi kahtlast. Rein astub baaridaami kaitseks välja ja mässib ennast tahtmatultarmukolmnurka. Samas vapustab aga üldsust järjekordsete riigikogulaste kadumine ja olukord terves politseistruktuuris muutub ülimalt kriitiliseks.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: Kõrgelt hinnatud vestern, kus Ameerika suurima rantšo peremees John Dutton (Kevin Costner) peab koos perega kaitsma oma valdusi kõigi vastu, kellega nende maa-alad piirnevad. Duttoni pere maid ihkavad nii laienev linn, indiaanlaste reservaat kui ka Ameerika esimene rahvuspark.

Agentuuris toimub noore kuulsa kirjaniku raamatuesitlus, samal ajal kui tüdrukute vahel pinged kasvavad ja loomulikult läheb nässu kõik mis annab nässu minna. Kristinast ja Mariast on saanud rivaalid, kui Kristina tahab vägisi noorest kirjanikust enda unistuste meest teha. Miša kardab aga, et teda hakatakse tülika pärandusemaja süütamises süüdistama.

Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Reinu naine kahtlustab Reinu petmises ja hakkab teda jälitama. Rein omakorda kardab, et sisekontroll on tema vastu huvi tundma hakanud ja seepärast tuleb kodus kiiresti Kuuno piraatkaubast lahti saada. Jaoskonnas üritab Rein aga koos Hans-Kristjaniga uue ülemuse vastu salaplaani haududa. Relika ja Rein jäävad lifti kinni ja saavad viimaks normaalselt rääkida, samas kui veel üks jaoskonna töötaja saab vallandamisteate. Reinu naine korraldab Reinule lõksu ja Reinul on nüüd väga raske selgitada, et ta on Renatele truu olnud. Rein saab riigikogulaste kadumise kohta ootamatu vihje ja osaleb ohtlikus tagaajamises.

programme.title: Kaks kanget Jaapanis
programme.desc: Kaks kanget alustavad peadpööritavat seiklust maailma ühes kõige erilisemas riigis Jaapanis. Saanud kaasa õnnistuse sumomaadlejalt Barutolt endalt, maanduvad nad pealinnas Tokyos. Pärast lõputut ekslemist maa-aluses metroorägastikus tuhisevad Teet ja Kristjan Jaapani kõige kuulsama kiirrongi Shinkanseniga riigi põhjaossa Hirosakisse, kus neid ootavad roosasse vahtu uppunud kirsipuud. Aga ka esimene kohtumine jaapani laulvate vetsupottidega.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Seltskond suundub suusa nädalavahetusele, aga Brenda jääb koju ning leiab vana päeviku, mis kuulus noorele naisele, kes elas 1960. aastate lõpus Walshi majas. Brenda kujutab end ette noore tüdruku Wendyna ja oma sõpru hipidena.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Madeline üritab kätte saada olulist dokumenti, mis sisaldab Wellbrexa juhtumiga seotud teavet.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: P.S. Ma armastan sind
programme.desc: Romantiline draama noorest kaunist Holly Kennedyst, kelle elu armastus, abikaasa Gerry, raske haiguse tõttu sureb. Holly maailm variseb kokku ning ainus, kes suudaks ta jalule aidata, on see, keda enam pole. Ent enne surma tegi mees kõik endast oleneva, et oma armastatut rasketel hetkedel aidata. Holly 30. sünnipäeval jõuab temani ootamatu saadetis...

programme.title: Nõiduslik lelupood
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline mänguasjapoe omanik soovib pensionile jääda ja palkab raamatupidaja. Häbelik noormees peab vormistama lelupoe ümber Molly-nimelise tütarlapse nimele, kes on kaotanud huvi elu vastu.

programme.title: Lapsehoidja päevikud
programme.desc: Rikka New Yorgi pere lapsehoidjana taskuraha teeniv tudengineiu on mässitud oma tööandjate keerulistesse pereprobleemidesse ja omaenda armusuhetesse.

programme.title: Napoleon Dynamite
programme.desc: Ükskõikne ja kõigist võõrandunud teismeline otsustab aidata uuel sõbral saada klassivanemaks. Samal ajal jagab sõber maid koju jäänud veidrikest pereliikmetega.

programme.title: Saage tuttavaks - Dave
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Elizabeth Banks, Marc Blucas, Gabrielle Union, Ed Helms, Scott Caan Värskelt New Yorki saabunud Dave Ming Chang (Eddie Murphy) on otsekui kala kuival. Miski tema juures on viltu, mees näeb kõike ümbritsevat otsekui esimest korda ega tunne end oma kehas kuigi mugavalt. Põhjusega, sest tegelikult ei olegi "Dave" üldse inimene, vaid hoopis teiselt planeedilt saabunud… kosmoselaev, mis on loodud oma kapteni (Eddie Murphy) näo järgi. Avastusretk tundmatusse maailma alaku!

programme.title: Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Laulukirjutaja Dave Seville (Jason Lee) on meeleheitel, sest teda kimbutavad lakkamatult kolm koopaoravat Alvin, Simon ja Theodore. Ühel heal päeval tekib mehel hiilgav idee: mis siis, kui tema laule esitaks needsamad oravad? Asjal on ka oma varjukülg. Kuigi kolmikust saab tõeline popsensatsioon, mõjuvad nad vägagi laastavalt Dave'i kodule ja karjäärile, pöörates tema seni tavalise elu täiesti pea peale.

programme.title: Scott Pilgrim terve maailma vastu
programme.desc: Scott Pilgrim kohtab oma unelmate neidu. Kuid peagi tuleb tal võistelda kõigi neiu endiste kallimatega, muuhulgas tuntud rulasõitja, vegan-rokkari ja kurjade kaksikvendadega.

programme.title: IQ
programme.desc: Mehaanik kurameerib Albert Einsteini matemaatikust nõoga, abiks geniaalne teadlane ise ja tema sõbrad.

programme.title: Bumerang
programme.desc: Kui edukast tegevjuhist seelikuküti uus naisülemus on temast veel kõlvatum, avastab mees, et tema eluviis on tema enda vastu pöördunud.

programme.title: Veetluse reeglid
programme.desc: Iirimaa-Suurbritannia-Saksamaa 2004 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja:Peter Howitt Osades:Pierce Brosnan, Julianne Moore, Parker Posey Daniel Rafferty (Pierce Brosnan) ja Aidrey woods (Julianne Moore) on kaks New Yorgi edukat lahutusadvokaati, kes on mõlemad tänaseni vallalised, sest nad on näinud, kui kaugele halva lõpuni võib viia abielu. Nad peavad esindama kuulsat rockstaari ning selle tõttu peavad nad sõitma Iirimaale. Seal toimub ka suur pidu ja järgmisel hommikul ärgates saavad nad teada väga veidra asja - nad abiellusid eelmine õhtu. New Yorki tagasi sõites peavad nad otsustama, kas lõpetada see suhe või äkki ongi parem ennem armumist abielluda?

programme.title: Jackass number kaks
programme.desc: Chris Pontius, Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O ja kõik teised on taas ekraanil ja panused on kõrgemad kui kunagi varem.
